entries.summary: maxRetainedBytes (default 16 MiB) bounds only native and tool payloads: past it the oldest are elided in place and the task keeps running; it also covers runtime request and reply native payloads. Text and reasoning are kept whole because the folds read them, so it is not a bound on total retained bytes (#2056). For Claude this is the existing behavior (since #1892). For Codex, Grok, Antigravity, OpenCode and dsh it changes: their text used to count toward the 16 MiB total and passing it failed the task ('<runtime> retained record byte budget exceeded'); that failure no longer occurs and their text has no byte bound. ClaudeAdapterOptions gains maxRetainedBytes. A task's text grows with the provider's per-turn output limit times the number of turns; a Host that needs a hard bound sets maxDurationMs (the offer's limits.maxDurationMs, or DaemonConfig.defaultMaxDurationMs).
